coverage.scope: Selected public owned repositories; default branches; authored non-merge commits

methodology: One candle per UTC calendar week, starting Monday. The index starts at zero at the beginning of the displayed window. Commits are ordered by Git committer timestamp, then SHA. For each commit, additions raise the index before deletions lower it. Open is the previous close; high and low capture those constructed excursions; close is cumulative additions minus deletions. The additions-first convention is a visualization rule, not a measured within-commit timeline. Only commits authored by the configured GitHub user and reachable from selected public repositories' default branches are counted. Merge commits are excluded to avoid recounting merged changes. Identical SHAs across repositories are counted once. Binary-file changes may have zero line statistics. Line volume is activity, not productivity or financial value.
